items.title: The category of dotted arrows is a groupoid, and a setoid when the diagonal is separated
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project — Morphisms of Algebraic Stacks

items.difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that in the situation of the valuative criterion the category of dotted arrows is a groupoid, and a setoid as soon as the diagonal of the morphism is separated (author lemma at source lines 9114-9119, label lemma-cat-dotted-arrows). The proof (source lines 9121-9148) records that the groupoid statement is immediate from the invertibility of 2-arrows, rewrites an automorphism of a dotted arrow as a point of the relative inertia pulled back along the arrow which becomes trivial over the fraction field, and concludes by the equivalence between separatedness of the diagonal and the closedness of the identity section of that group algebraic space (proof lines 9122-9147). The reformulation of the two compatibility conditions as a point of the pulled back inertia is the content. H2.
